title: The Audit Decides the Verdict: Instrument Effects Rival Demographic Bias in LLM Decision Audits

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution (correspondence audit) in prompts across decision-making scenarios (hiring, lending, medical triage) using applicant names chosen to signal specific racial and ethnic identities (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian).
